description: PRM5 AlphaFold confidence profile, CA-geometry secondary structure, compactness, and Foldseek result table
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, json

pdb = requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-P40476-F1-model_v6.pdb", timeout=120).text
seq = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P40476.json", timeout=90).json()['sequence']['value']

ca={}; plddt={}
for L in pdb.splitlines():
    if L.startswith("ATOM") and L[12:16].strip()=="CA":
        i=int(L[22:26]); ca[i]=(float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])); plddt[i]=float(L[60:66])
idx=sorted(ca); X=np.array([ca[i] for i in idx]); P=np.array([plddt[i] for i in idx]); n=len(idx)

# P-SEA-style CA-only secondary structure: helix if d(i,i+3)~5.3, d(i,i+4)~6.4; strand if d(i,i+2)~6.7, d(i,i+3)~9.9
def d(a,b): return np.linalg.norm(X[a]-X[b])
ss=np.array(['C']*n)
for i in range(n-4):
    if abs(d(i,i+3)-5.3)<0.8 and abs(d(i,i+4)-6.4)<0.9: ss[i:i+5]='H'
for i in range(n-3):
    if ss[i]!='H' and abs(d(i,i+2)-6.7)<0.7 and abs(d(i,i+3)-9.9)<1.2: ss[i:i+4]='E'
print("Secondary structure content (CA geometry, P-SEA-like):")
for c,lab in [('H','helix'),('E','strand'),('C','coil')]:
    print(f"   {lab:7s} {(ss==c).sum():4d}/{n}  {100*(ss==c).mean():5.1f}%")

# radius of gyration + compactness vs expectation for a globular protein of this size
Rg=np.sqrt(((X-X.mean(0))**2).sum(1).mean())
Rg_glob=2.2*n**0.38   # Flory globular scaling (A)
print(f"\nRadius of gyration = {Rg:.1f} A ; expected globular Rg for {n} res = {Rg_glob:.1f} A ; ratio = {Rg/Rg_glob:.2f}")
# ordered (pLDDT>70) residues
ordered=np.where(P>70)[0]+1
print("Ordered (pLDDT>70) residue indices span:", ordered.min(), "-", ordered.max(), " n =", len(ordered))
runs=[]; s=ordered[0]; prev=ordered[0]
for v in ordered[1:]:
    if v!=prev+1: runs.append((s,prev)); s=v
    prev=v
runs.append((s,prev))
print("Contiguous ordered segments (>=4 res):", [(a,b,b-a+1) for a,b in runs if b-a+1>=4])

# ---- Foldseek result summary table (from the runs above) ----
fs = pd.DataFrame([
 dict(mode="3diaa", database="PDB100",         hits=0, best_target="-", prob=np.nan, evalue=np.nan, aln_len=np.nan, q_cov=np.nan),
 dict(mode="3diaa", database="AFDB50",         hits=0, best_target="-", prob=np.nan, evalue=np.nan, aln_len=np.nan, q_cov=np.nan),
 dict(mode="3diaa", database="AFDB-SwissProt", hits=1, best_target="AF-P40476 (self)", prob=1.0, evalue=7.77e-45, aln_len=318, q_cov=1.00),
 dict(mode="3diaa", database="CATH50",         hits=1, best_target="af_Q8IDL6_1254_1387_3.30.70.240 (P. falciparum)", prob=0.034, evalue=9.107, aln_len=38, q_cov=38/318),
 dict(mode="tmalign", database="PDB100",       hits=0, best_target="-", prob=np.nan, evalue=np.nan, aln_len=np.nan, q_cov=np.nan),
 dict(mode="tmalign", database="AFDB50",       hits=0, best_target="-", prob=np.nan, evalue=np.nan, aln_len=np.nan, q_cov=np.nan),
 dict(mode="3diaa", database="PDB100 (CONTROL PGK1/P00560)", hits=271, best_target="1qpg_A", prob=1.0, evalue=1.1e-77, aln_len=415, q_cov=415/416),
 dict(mode="3diaa", database="AFDB50 (CONTROL PGK1/P00560)", hits=1000, best_target="AF-A0A9W7T1E1", prob=1.0, evalue=7.9e-69, aln_len=419, q_cov=np.nan),
])
pd.set_option('display.width',200); print("\n", fs.to_string(index=False))
fs.to_csv('/tmp/foldseek_summary.csv', index=False)

# ---------- FIGURE ----------
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2,1, figsize=(12,7), height_ratios=[2,1])
ax=axes[0]
ax.fill_between(idx, 0, P, color='#9aa7b8', alpha=.35, lw=0)
ax.plot(idx, P, color='#2b4c7e', lw=1.4)
for y,c in [(90,'#1b7f3b'),(70,'#c77b14'),(50,'#b4413d')]:
    ax.axhline(y, color=c, ls='--', lw=.9)
    ax.text(321, y, {90:'very high',70:'confident',50:'low'}[y], color=c, va='center', fontsize=8)
ax.axvspan(75,98, color='#1b7f3b', alpha=.18)
ax.text(86.5, 103, 'TM helix\n75-98', ha='center', fontsize=9, color='#1b7f3b')
ax.axvspan(1,74, color='#999999', alpha=.10); ax.text(37,103,'Ser/Thr-rich\n1-74', ha='center', fontsize=9, color='#555')
ax.axvspan(99,318, color='#b4413d', alpha=.07); ax.text(208,103,'cytoplasmic, low confidence 99-318', ha='center', fontsize=9, color='#8c3330')
ax.set_ylim(0,100); ax.set_xlim(1,318); ax.set_ylabel('pLDDT'); ax.set_xticklabels([])
ax.set_title('AlphaFold confidence for S. cerevisiae PRM5 (P40476), mean pLDDT 57.2\n'
             'Foldseek: 0 hits in PDB100 and AFDB50 (3Di-AA and TM-align modes); control PGK1 returns 271 PDB hits',
             fontsize=11, loc='left')
ax2=axes[1]
colmap={'H':'#2b7fbd','E':'#d08c1f','C':'#cccccc'}
for i,c in enumerate(ss):
    ax2.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((idx[i]-0.5,0),1,1,color=colmap[c],lw=0))
ax2.set_xlim(1,318); ax2.set_ylim(0,1); ax2.set_yticks([])
ax2.set_xlabel('residue')
ax2.set_title(f'Secondary structure from model geometry: helix {100*(ss=="H").mean():.0f}%, '
              f'strand {100*(ss=="E").mean():.0f}%, coil {100*(ss=="C").mean():.0f}%  (no beta sheet, no globular core)',
              fontsize=9, loc='left')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
